concerns.text: T015 (3D conformer generation) is marked [P] (parallel-safe) but explicitly depends on T008b (conformer_params generator) and T014 (graph features). The task description states 'Invoke the utility from T008b' and 'Dependency: Must run after T014'. A task cannot be parallel-safe if it consumes artifacts produced by specific preceding tasks in the same phase. The [P] tag is semantically incorrect here.

T016 (Data Splitting) is marked [P] but depends on T014 (Molecular Weight) and T015 (SASA values). The description explicitly states 'Must run after T014... and T015'. This is a strict sequential dependency; the task cannot run in parallel with its producers.

T021b (Geometry-Based Baseline) is marked [P] but depends on T016 (split indices) and T015 (processed dataset with 3D conformers). The description states 'Must use the split indices from... T016' and 'processed dataset from T015'. This violates the producer-before-consumer rule for parallel tagging.

T022 (Training Loop) is marked [P] but depends on T050 (Gradient Accumulation logic) and implicitly on T021a (Model Definition). The description states 'incorporating gradient accumulation logic from T050'. If T050 is a prerequisite logic block, T022 cannot be parallel-safe relative to it. Furthermore, training requires the dataset from Phase 3, making it sequential to the entire data pipeline.

T028 (Sensitivity Analysis) is marked [P] but depends on T040 (Performance Metrics) and T028 (Absolute - self-reference error in text, likely meant T021b/T022). The description states 'Must run after T040... and T028'. Since T040 depends on model training (T021b/T022), T028 is strictly sequential to the model phase. The [P] tag is invalid.

T017 (Validation/Error Handling) is marked [P] but logically must run after or concurrently with T014/T015 to catch their failures. If it is a separate task, it consumes the output of T014/T015. If it is a 'check' task, it cannot be parallel to the generation tasks it validates. The [P] tag implies independence which contradicts the error-handling dependency.

T015 description contains a circular dependency note: 'Dependency: Must run after T014... and T015'. It likely meant 'T014 and T008b'. This needs correction for clarity, though the semantic ordering violation (T015 after T014) is the primary issue.

T028 description states 'Must run after... T028 (Absolute)'. This is a self-reference error. It should likely reference T021b/T022 or T040. This is a writing nit but obscures the true dependency chain.
